target_customer: Software developers who run many coding agents in parallel
problem: Running agents in parallel overwhelms attention because developers scroll through chat and tool calls instead of reviewing finished work.
business_model: Free desktop and iPhone app; monetization not shown, pricing section lists no plans

founders.name: Alon Zuman
previous_startups: Pops (AI games app, launched on YC)
founders.background_notes: YC page says six years building creative tools used by millions, most recently at Playground AI.

competitors.name: Conductor
competitors.what: Mac app running Claude Code, Codex and others in parallel across git worktrees

competitors.name: Vibe Kanban
competitors.traction_then: Company behind it reportedly shut down April 2026; project now community maintained

competitors.name: Cursor cloud agents
competitors.what: Background agents running with the laptop closed

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross-platform app orchestrating many third-party agents, generating review artifacts such as reports and before-and-after videos.

defensibility.rationale: Agent vendors and many tools ship similar parallel agent management; users bring their own agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Model and IDE vendors pushed parallel agent workflows in 2026; no action aimed specifically at Current found.

market_need_then: By 2026 roughly all developers used AI workflows per newsletters, and many guides compared tools for running multiple agents, showing demand for orchestration.

branding.domain_note: Uses joincurrent.io; company listed as Undefined Software, Inc.

identity.logo: Simple Current wordmark with a small logo mark
identity.visual_style: Minimal; features a J. M. W. Turner painting from the Metropolitan Museum
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct; tagline Run hundreds of agents. Stay in control.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with other products named Current in agent tooling; no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Current is a single-founder Spring 2026 company in the crowded coding agent management category. It is free with no disclosed traction. The main risk is that model vendors and IDEs absorb parallel agent review, while its angle is reviewing outputs rather than chats.
notes: No funding information found in any source. No independent coverage of Current found. Education not listed. The site and YC differ on platforms: YC says Mac, Windows, Linux and iPhone while the site download offered a macOS dmg.
